items.title: David N. Baker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The main characters are [portrayed by actors] William Marshall and Rafer Johnson.

ctx.x: . . . four episodes. The main characters are [portrayed by actors] William Marshall and Rafer Johnson. It’s about black cowboys in the West. I did a second series called The Trial of Captain Henry Flipper, who was the first black at West Point and was drummed out of the service unfairly. He was cleared many, many years later. Those [are the] two TV series I’ve written, and I’ve written any number of commercial TV pieces that were not part of series.
I can remember at one point Quincy [Jones] was lobbying you really hard to come out to Hollywood and become a film and TV writer.
